claims.text: The funding is for research, development, and analysis projects.
Projects must address one or more of five strategic priority questions.
The strategic priority questions relate to a prosperous and fair society, inclusive society, science and technology, climate policy, and effective institutions.
Project duration is usually between six months and three years.

claims.text: Research funding is available to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society.
The funding focuses on racial diversity within the UK.
The 2026 priority theme is 'Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK'.
There is one deadline a year for this fund, in the Autumn.
The next deadline is October 5, 2026.

records.justification: The agent's text captures most of the eligibility criteria but omits the specific types of UK-based organisations and the duration requirement for affiliation, as well as the impact criterion.

claims.text: Applicants must be employed by or have a formal affiliation with a UK-based organisation.
The UK-based organisation must be a university, research organisation, or voluntary sector body.
The affiliation must be for at least the duration of the project.
Unaffiliated individuals are excluded.
Projects led by schools or FE colleges are excluded.
Undergraduates or master's students are excluded.
PhD-fee projects are excluded.
Establishment of academic posts is excluded.
Non-UK-led organisations are excluded, except in exceptional cases.
Overseas hosts are only exceptionally permitted.
The research must have a clear path to making a difference to people's lives.
